title: Acceptable sources for risk adjustment
question: Can this document support a diagnosis code for risk adjustment? Assign the code it supports, or 'no code' if it cannot be used.
note: Based on CMS RADV medical record reviewer guidance and the Medicare Managed Care Manual, chapter 7: a face-to-face visit with an acceptable provider type, signed with credentials. Diagnostic radiology and documents from non-acceptable provider types are not acceptable sources.

labels.office_visit: Signed office visit with a physician, NP or PA

describe.office_visit: A face-to-face office visit for COPD follow-up; the provider examines the patient, assesses COPD as stable and continues the inhaler.
describe.radiology_report: The only document for this date is a diagnostic chest x-ray report by a radiologist; the Impression says hyperinflation and findings consistent with COPD.
describe.nurse_visit: A nurse visit for inhaler teaching with a registered nurse (RN), who is the only clinician seeing the patient today. The nurse notes the patient's known COPD.
describe.unsigned_note: A face-to-face office visit for COPD follow-up; COPD is assessed as stable and the inhaler continued, but the note was never signed. Include the line 'Note status: unsigned'.

note_rules.document: Write a diagnostic radiology report for a two-view chest x-ray, dictated and signed by a radiologist, with sections: Exam, Indication, Comparison, Technique, Findings, Impression, and a final line 'Interpreting radiologist:' with the signature. It is not an office visit note: no HPI, medication list, assessment or plan.
Write a nurse visit note by a registered nurse (RN), with sections: Reason for Visit, Vitals, Nursing Assessment, Patient Education, Plan. The nurse is the only clinician who sees the patient today.

coded_radiology_report.description: Coded from a diagnostic radiology report, which is not an acceptable risk-adjustment source.

coded_non_acceptable_provider.description: Coded from a visit with a provider type that is not acceptable (e.g. a nurse visit).

coded_unsigned_note.description: Coded from a note without a provider signature and credentials.

rejected_acceptable_source.description: Assigned no code although a signed face-to-face visit with an acceptable provider supports it.

rules.explain: A signed face-to-face visit with an acceptable provider (MD, DO, NP or PA) that assesses COPD supports J44.9 (HCC 280).

wrong.why: The visit is face to face, signed with credentials and addresses COPD: it supports J44.9.

rules.explain: Diagnostic radiology is not an acceptable risk-adjustment source: radiologists do not document confirmed diagnoses for the patient's care. No code.

wrong.why: 'Consistent with COPD' on an x-ray report is not a provider's diagnosis for risk adjustment.

rules.explain: A registered nurse is not an acceptable provider type for risk adjustment; the visit needs a physician or other acceptable clinician. No code.

wrong.why: A nurse visit alone cannot support the diagnosis.

rules.explain: A note must be signed with the provider's credentials to be used. Unsigned: no code (ask the provider to sign it).

wrong.why: Without a signature and credentials the note cannot support a code.
